# Copilot repository instructions

Follow [the shared working agreement](../AGENTS.md). Read `AgentDATA/context/project.md` and
`AgentDATA/context/handoff.md` before substantive changes; load relevant procedures as needed.
This repository is hosted on GitLab. Use its issues and merge requests, discover
the actual host, and use GitLab tooling when available. The `.github/` directory
configures Copilot locally; it does not select GitHub as the hosting platform.
For setup or substantial context changes, use the bootstrap-project skill.
